problem: Your small diamond earring has fallen down a narrow-width, metal heat vent with a sharp curve deep into its passage. The vent is positioned low, at floor level. You have a stretchy rubber band, a wide, fluorescent highlighter, a digital pocket camera, an extendable microfiber duster, a pack of mint chewing gum, and a small round handheld mirror designed for makeup application.
objects: a pack of mint chewing gum
a small round handheld makeup mirror

goldSolution: Use the extendable microfiber duster to measure the depth of the vent.
Attach the round handheld mirror to the duster using the rubber band.
Insert the mirror-duster into the vent, using the mirror to locate the earring.
Use the fluorescent highlighter to mark the spot on the duster where it reaches the earring.
Remove the mirror and replace it with the gum at the marked spot.
Carefully lower the duster back into the vent to stick the earring to the gum.
Slowly pull the duster back up to retrieve the earring.
